description: Dancers pass along a line giving alternate hands to each dancer they meet.

walkthrough.line: Right hand to the one facing you, pull by; left to the next; right to the one after.
walkthrough.teach: Give your right hand to the dancer facing you along the line and pull by, then give your left to the next one and pull by, then your right hand to the one after that. Keep going the way you started — three hands, two beats each — and let the line run past you.

call.4: GRAND RIGHT AND LEFT THREE HANDS
